title: Spellforge Insectarium
description: A woman with long pink braided hair in a black insect-patterned dress stands at a glowing Spellforge Insectarium vending machine dispensing colorful moths and beetles, chained to the machine. In the background a man with a red backpack stands on a purple cliff edge overlooking a surreal landscape, while a large chained bubble in the starry sky contains four stylized female heads in purple, green, pink and yellow.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene at night, a woman with long pink braids wearing a black dress covered in white insect illustrations stands at a glowing vending machine labeled Spellforge Insectarium Garden of Chams, dispensing colorful moths and beetles with magical light, the machine is chained with orange chains. In the background a hiker with red backpack stands on the edge of a purple rocky cliff looking at a distant castle, above them floats a large transparent bubble chained in the starry sky containing four stylized female heads in purple green pink and yellow, dramatic colorful clouds, mystical atmosphere.
